claims.subject: Hochwald
claims.object: cooperative dairy and food group processing >2bn kg milk annually
claims.claim: Hochwald describes itself as a cooperatively structured dairy and food group that processes more than two billion kilograms of milk annually; its cooperative board and supervisory board include volunteer farmers.
claims.boundary: A cooperative structure and annual milk volume do not identify individual farms, cows, plant destinations or product paths.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company or audited disclosure materially changes the structure or annual milk scale.

claims.subject: Hochwald Group
claims.object: €2.0109bn revenue, 2.2845bn kg milk deliveries and 1,970 employees
claims.claim: Hochwald's 2025 report on financial year 2024 states revenue of €2.0109 billion, milk deliveries of 2.2845 billion kilograms and 1,970 employees.
claims.boundary: These are 2024 group figures and do not identify current farm count, animal numbers or the allocation of milk to particular products and sites.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected financial disclosure restates the 2024 figures.

claims.subject: Hochwald Milch eG member farms
claims.object: about 92 cows per member farm and nearly 9,000 people working on member farms
claims.claim: Hochwald states that nearly 9,000 people work on its cooperative member farms and reports an average of 92 cows per member operation.
claims.boundary: An average herd size does not describe every member farm and should not be multiplied into a total cow estimate without a current member-farm denominator.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer cooperative disclosure materially changes the average herd or workforce context.

claims.subject: Hochwald member-farm milk
claims.object: Hochwald production sites in the cooperative milk catchment
claims.claim: Hochwald states that milk produced on cooperative member farms is processed in Hochwald plants and that its production sites in Germany and the Netherlands are located within the cooperative's milk catchment area.
claims.boundary: This does not identify which member farm supplies which specific dairy or trace a milk batch to a particular brand/product.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the milk-catchment or plant relationship.

claims.subject: Hochwald cooperative milk
claims.object: 100% QMilch-certified; about 95% suppliers in QM sustainability module
claims.claim: Hochwald states that 100 percent of its cooperative milk has been QMilch-certified since 2004 and that around 95 percent of its suppliers have participated in the QM sustainability module.
claims.boundary: Certification or programme participation does not by itself prove compliance in every case or quantify animal-based welfare outcomes.
claims.falsification_condition: A current Hochwald/QM disclosure materially changes certification or programme coverage.

claims.subject: Hochwald Mechernich dairy
claims.object: around 800 million kg milk across 17 systems at opening
claims.claim: When commissioning its Mechernich dairy, Hochwald stated that around 800 million kilograms of milk per year would be processed there across 17 systems, with capacity for further expansion.
claims.source_title: Hochwald — Molkerei der Zukunft in Betrieb
claims.boundary: Commissioning capacity is not a current utilisation figure and does not identify farm-level milk origin or product destination.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official site disclosure materially changes the plant capacity or operating role.
